## Teaching Rhythm (2 hours per week)

- 0-20 min: Biological framing and key question
- 20-50 min: Guided model or data walkthrough
- 50-95 min: Notebook-based exploration and exercises
- 95-120 min: Interpretation, synthesis, and wrap-up
